items.geometryScope: Closed extrusion hypothesis of the selected visible face. Thickness, rear face and end caps are assumptions; no claim of complete physical housing reconstruction.

items.minimumHeightScope: The volume minimum includes invented rear geometry and is not a physical clearance measurement
